description: Weather per hour and station. Returns a list of records; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Fields: station_id (varchar): SMHI station id; station (varchar); parameter (varchar): 1 temperature, 4 wind speed, 6 humidity, 7 precipitation; unit (varchar); observed_at (timestamptz); date (date): Day (Europe/Stockholm); value (double); quality (varchar): G checked, Y suspect (latest-hour data is not quality-controlled). Attribution required when the data is shown: Contains data from SMHI (Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute), CC BY 4.0
